decision: authoring/decisions.md (Icons, amended 2026-10-19): Phosphor is imported locally because the community library is not available to the file; designers reach the glyphs only through the Icon component or a component's icon slot.

notes.name: Phosphor — Library notes
notes.content: import record (set, date, source, license, names, construction, script), how to use (through Icon only), updating

components.construction: 24 × 24 component with a transparent background; one vector named Glyph, drawn on the 256 grid (inset 1/8), Scale constraints, fill bound to color/content/primary (Foundations · Appearance, VariableID:7:10); description with the version, the license and the usage rule
components.layout: alphabetical grid, 40 columns, 48 px apart, from y = 960 below the notes frame
components.import: SVG files uploaded through the Figma MCP upload_assets tool (one frame per file, named after the icon), then converted in place by the builder script

consumers.Icon: component set 149:20, property Glyph#149:0 defaults to phosphor/plus (200:4367), no preferred values; reports/components/icon/figma/ledger.json

replaced._Fixture/Icon: component set 74:2 (plus 42:7, arrow-right 42:10, trash 42:13, download-simple 42:16, check 42:19) and its frame 42:2 on Utilities, deleted on 2026-10-19 after every instance was swapped to the Phosphor components (identical vectors)

verification: 1,512 components on the page, one per file of assets/regular in the package; 12 uploads that failed on the first pass were retried, one duplicate frame removed.
The five glyphs that replaced the fixtures have vector paths byte-identical to the fixtures'.
Specification frames Icon (152:7) and Button (126:1904) inspected after the swap: no visual change.
limitations: Library not published: publication needs explicit authorization.
Other weights (thin, light, bold, fill, duotone) are not imported.
